## Statement · **draft**
Let $A$ be a commutative ring with identity and $P \subset A$ a proper ideal. Then $P$ is a **prime ideal** if

$a b \in P \implies a \in P \ \text{or}\ b \in P \qquad (a, b \in A).$

Equivalently, the quotient ring $A/P$ is a **domain** (see `def.quotient-ring`).
